title: Leaf-cohort applied-transfer structural seam

source_basis.pcse_reference_semantics: after old-leaf death and ageing, uniformly scale all surviving old cohorts before adding new growth

required_gates: interior proportional scaling matches pinned PCSE semantics
full depletion produces zero surviving cohort biomass
applied transfer above surviving biomass fails closed
zero-size cohort set accepts only zero applied transfer
cohort order and relative proportions are preserved in the interior
mass residual remains within explicit floating-point closure tolerance
O0 and O2 outputs are identical
